title: NarrativeStep
description: Schema for NarrativeStep objects — one step within a NarrativePreset. Each step defines a graph state (which nodes are focused, which edges are visible, camera position) and narrative text (headline, body). Steps reference entity IDs from the canonical graph and anchor IDs from narrative-anchors.json.

id.description: Unique identifier for this step. Convention: {presetId}_step_{N}.

order.description: 1-based position of this step within the preset.

headline.description: Short headline displayed at the top of the narrative card. Typically one sentence.

body.description: Explanatory text for this step. 2-5 sentences. Should connect the graph state to the thesis argument.

bodyFr.description: French version of the body text.

bridgeEntityIds.description: GRC-20 entity IDs to focus on in this step. These nodes will be highlighted in the graph.

bridgeEntityNames.description: Entity names as fallback resolution for bridgeEntityIds (used when IDs are not yet resolved).

anchorQuoteIds.description: NarrativeAnchor IDs from narrative-anchors.json that are displayed in this step.

graphAction.description: Graph action to perform when entering this step.

edgeMode.description: Which edges to display in this step. 'none' = nodes only. 'primary' = direct neighbor edges. 'all' = full edge set.

secondaryDepth.description: Hop depth for secondary nodes shown alongside focal nodes.

chapterFilter.description: If set, restricts displayed nodes to this chapter index only.

typeFilter.description: Entity type names to display in this step (others are hidden). Empty array = show all types.

examples.headline: September 2018: A critical bug is silently fixed
examples.headlineFr: Septembre 2018 : un bug critique est corrigé en silence
examples.body: CVE-2018-17144 was a critical inflation vulnerability in Bitcoin Core. Its disclosure and fix were coordinated privately among a small group of developers — without public announcement, forum post, or BIP.
